newsitem.title: UK: London gold closes stronger, silver ends off highs.
newsitem.headline: London gold closes stronger, silver ends off highs.

text.p: GOLD - Ends $3.90 higher at $353.10/$353.60 after bouncing off Thursday's 40-month low on back of silver.SILVER - Closes two cents higher at $4.90/$4.92. Off highs approaching $5.00 after rally momentum wanes.PLATINUM - Finishes $1.40 stronger at $357.65/$358.65 with gold. PALLADIUM - Ends up $1.00 at $122.00/$123.00.
